declined.subject: table
declined.reason: The subject's precondition clearly does not hold: TextInput, Select, Checkbox, SegmentedControl and the other files are form primitives, and a grep of these files for <table, role="grid", aria-sort, useTableSort and TablePager found nothing. But their directory, app/_components, also holds app/_components/table/ (ColumnHead, TablePager, TableStatus). A directory-wide absence search would hit those files, so I can't state not-applicable in a form the driver would accept. Marking it conformant or deviation would be invented.
